name: Xhorse3D Xmachine WM-100
notes: Live Kickstarter campaign (HK-based, pledges in HKD) ending 25.10.2026. Price = Super Early Bird, creator-stated US$5,899 (HK$46,248), incl. standard kit with wireless probe; MSRP US$8,399; shipping extra (DAP), first batch planned Jan 2027. Per Xhorse3D's 29.08.2026 announcement the WM-100 needs an NSG export license and the campaign is open only to businesses/institutions; individual export applications have so far been rejected. A-axis -30° to 110°, C-axis 360°; max workpiece Ø140 × 120 / 110 × 110 × 120 mm (5-axis), 150 × 150 × 120 mm (3+2); A/C accuracy ±50", repeatability ±10". Spindle 1.5 kW, 0.6 N·m rated / 1.3 N·m max, max tool Ø6 mm; servo ATC; laser-scanning workpiece positioning, built-in camera, plasma anti-static module. Machine rated power 2.2 kW.

accessories.name: Wireless Probe
accessories.description: Additional wireless touch probe for automatic centering, workpiece measurement and axis calibration (one is already in the Kickstarter standard kit).

accessories.name: Xscanner 3D Laser Scanner
accessories.description: Xhorse3D handheld 3D laser scanner for capturing objects to reproduce on the machine.

accessories.name: SYNDRA High-Efficiency Wet/Dry Dust Collector
accessories.description: Wet/dry dust and chip collector for the machine.

accessories.name: Basic HYDROX Self-Pressurizing Water Tank
accessories.description: Coolant tank with built-in water and air pumps for mist cooling without an external air compressor.

accessories.name: Vise Set (4 pcs)
accessories.description: Workholding set: 7-67 mm vise plus jaws for round stock Ø13-22, 22-40 and 40-86 mm.

accessories.name: Reduction Sleeve Set (9 pcs)
accessories.description: Sleeves reducing the 6 mm tool bore to 4, 3.175 and 3 mm shanks (3 each).

accessories.name: Tool Holder Set (12 pcs)
accessories.description: Tool rings (holders) with 6, 4, 3.175 and 3 mm inner diameter, three of each.
